content.question: Match each BERT concept with its role.

answer.[MASK]: A placeholder token that the model learns to reconstruct during pretraining
answer.[CLS]: A special token whose final representation feeds classification heads
answer.[SEP]: A separator token joining two segments, e.g., question and passage
answer.Bidirectional attention: Lets every token attend to both left and right context during pretraining
answer.Fine-tuning: A short supervised training phase adapting the pretrained encoder to a specific task
